name: Calmness
summary:
Your Sanctuary, Your Rules
Why settle for one way to relax when you can explore dozens? Calmness offers a diverse collection of "Living Rooms"—interactive environments designed to trigger an immediate relaxation response.Why Play Calmness?
We built this for the overthinkers, the late-night workers, and anyone who needs a five-minute escape from reality. It’s the perfect companion for meditation, study, or winding down before sleep.
Unlock the door. Leave the stress behind.
